description: The Baude main window's title bar: on the left the sessions-sidebar toggle, in the middle the open chat's name, on the right (right to left as built: ☰, side-panel toggle, Signal, mode, effort, model, provider) the chat's pickers and buttons. The window's own title is "Baude" or "Baude — <chat name>".

parts.name: sessions sidebar toggle
parts.shows: A toggle button at the far left with the left-sidebar icon; pressed while the sessions sidebar is shown. The sidebar's shown state is remembered between runs.

actions.does: Slides the sessions sidebar in or out
Same toggle, from anywhere in the window
Shows the sidebar and puts the focus in its search box

parts.name: title
parts.shows: The open chat's name, centred in the bar, one line, cut with … past 48 characters. A chat with no name yet reads "New session". The window title follows it ("Baude — <name>").

actions.does: Tooltip: "Rename: right-click the session in the sidebar, or F2". Clicking the title itself does not rename (renaming is done on the chat's row in the sidebar: right-click → Rename…, or F2 with the row focused)

parts.name: provider picker
parts.shows: Left of the model picker, a drop-down button with an arrow showing where the chat's model runs, written "<host> / <provider>" (for example "local / MLX"), cut with … in the middle past 24 characters. Only shown while the chat's model is one that runs on a provider (Ollama, MLX, Apple, an OpenAI-compatible server), never for Claude's own models.

actions.does: Opens the host/provider menu (see HostPicker); picking another moves the chat's model to its copy there, mid-turn once the turn is over

parts.name: model picker
parts.shows: A button with the family's logo and the picked model's name (for example "Opus 5.5"), cut with … past 30 characters, and a drop-down arrow. Before claude has said which model, it shows the model the default resolves to.

actions.does: Opens the model palette (see ModelPicker): search box over models grouped by family

parts.name: effort picker
parts.shows: A drop-down of the thinking-effort levels the current model supports, the current one shown. For a model without an effort setting the box reads "Effort" and is greyed out; for models of a program without effort it is hidden.

actions.does: Tooltip "Thinking effort"; when unavailable "{model} has no effort setting" ("This model has no effort setting" if no model name is known)
Opens the effort menu (see EffortMenu); the pick applies to the running chat and a quiet note says "thinking effort → <label>"

parts.name: mode picker
parts.shows: A drop-down of permission modes, the chat's mode shown (a new chat starts on Auto; a Codex-model chat starts on Manual). Hidden for models whose program has no permission modes unless the chat's host offers them.

actions.does: Opens the mode menu (see ModeMenu); the pick is sent to claude, which can refuse it

parts.name: Signal button
parts.shows: An icon-only menu button with a chain-link icon (no label, no tooltip). It sits between the mode picker and the side-panel toggle.

actions.does: Opens the Signal popover (see SignalMenu): two switches, Show links and Activate Signal, per chat

parts.name: side panel toggle
parts.shows: A toggle button with the right-sidebar icon; pressed while the side panel (subagents, processes, code, files, …) is shown.
text: Side panel: subagents, processes, code, files (Ctrl+Alt+B)

actions.does: Slides the side panel in or out
Shows and focuses Meta in the side panel, or closes it if already shown there

parts.name: menu button
parts.shows: The rightmost button: the three-bar ☰ icon (open-menu).

states.name: Claude's own model
states.shows: No provider picker; effort picker live for models that support it; mode picker shown

states.name: provider model
states.shows: Provider picker shown, greyed when only one provider has the model (tooltip: "Where the chat's model runs (the only one that has it)")

states.name: model without effort
states.shows: Effort picker reads "Effort", greyed, with the no-effort tooltip

states.name: mode refused
states.shows: The mode picker goes back to the mode claude is still in and a note in the chat says "couldn't switch to <mode>: <why> (still <was>)"
